jobs.description:
1 Project Manager - BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs, all genders Your skills that inspire us:
 * Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.
 * At least 5 years of professional experience in Technical Program Management, Product Management, Innovation Labs, R&D, Engineering Management, or a comparable technology-driven role.
 * Experience coordinating interdisciplinary teams and driving Proofs of Concept, prototypes, pilot projects, or technology initiatives from ideas to documented outcomes.
 * Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple initiatives across engineering, product management, and business teams.
 * Comfortable working in agile environments and facilitating sprint-based collaboration, workshops, or cross-functional planning activities.
 * Solid understanding of modern software development, cloud technologies, AI trends, media technologies, streaming, or digital platforms. You don't need to be a software developer, but you enjoy working closely with technical experts.
 * Experience collaborating with universities, research institutions, startups, public organizations, or technology partners is an advantage.
 * Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to represent BIG BLUE MARBLE confidently in national and international innovation networks, conferences, and partner meetings.
 * Experience preparing or contributing to technical blogs, conference papers, white papers, presentations, or similar publications is considered a strong asset.
 * You are a proactive, hands-on personality who enjoys bringing structure to innovation activities, connecting people, and turning promising ideas into tangible results.
 * Fluent English (C1/C2) and German (minimum B2) are required.

Here's what we're proposing for you:
In addition to an annual salary in line with the market, we offer you a package of benefits consisting of a mobility allowance for the Wiener Linien annual ticket or the KLIMATICKET, a company canteen, our bonus programme, the pension fund and a sports programme.

Place of work: Vienna (remote option), working hours: 38,5hours per week, reference number: OC1026CINSE, starting date: 08/2026. We are happy to offer professionals with relevant training and experience a gross annual salary in line with the market of between 56,000 and 72,000 euros (salary group 4, Telekom-KV, 38,5 h/week)*.

Remote work
Good communication and direct cooperation are very important to us. You can work from home, from the modern office or hybrid. In practice, this means that, according to your preferences, you will benefit from working remotely or from an office in Vienna with a great location and a cool atmosphere. We are happy to talk about the details in a meeting. 

Travel

This position includes occasional national and international business travel, with an expected travel commitment of up to four weeks per year, primarily for conferences, trade fairs, workshops, partner meetings, and industry events.

*For legal reasons, we are required to state the minimum salary as per the collective agreement. For this position, it is € 3.523,02 gross/month (Qualification Group 4, Specialist Level, Telekom collective agreement 2026, full-time). 

Why join us:
You are passionate about media and have a deep understanding of streaming, broadcasting and telecommunication. With experience in product- or project management and strong communication skills you are a key asset in every team. Analytical skills and the ability to understand complex scenarios and communicate in a management-friendly complete your skillset. Your enthusiasm, initiative and enthusiasm for realization make you an invaluable asset to our company.

This is you? Contact us via karriere.ors.at

jobs.occupation: Scrum Master & Cross-Team Facilitator (m/w/d)  - The Connector
jobs.description:
We are a deep-tech company that creates and produces internationally awarded smart glasses. Our headquarters is in Vienna, where we develop and manufacture both the hardware and the software of the smart glasses.

From research & development, engineering, production to marketing and sales - we offer everything from a single source under one roof. This will give you exciting insights into other departments of the company. Although we have our roots in Austria, we are "born global" and work with customers and sales partners all over the world.

Making Future Reality together - are you in? 1 Scrum Master & Cross-Team Facilitator (m/w/d)  - The Connector Vienna, fulltime

Tasks

What You'll Be Doing

 * Facilitate Scrum ceremonies for the team: stand-ups, planning, retros that people actually leave energised

 * Support task prioritisation and organisational clarity within the team

 * Spot and remove blockers before they slow anyone down

 * Act as the coordination bridge between teams (hardware, firmware, software, optics) because our work spans all of them

 * Keep stakeholders informed with just the right amount of communication, clear and easy, never a burden

 * Optimise the way of working to fit both the team's needs and the company's expectations, without applying standardised frameworks

 * Maintain and improve the team's task and documentation system: hands-on work in ClickUp

 * Build a culture of trust, transparency, and continuous improvement

Requirements

What You Bring to the Team

 * Proven experience as a Scrum Master or Agile facilitator, ideally in a technical or engineering-heavy environment

 * Real cross-team coordination experience, you've managed dependencies, timelines, and communication across multiple teams simultaneously

 * You're comfortable in ambiguity, a deep-tech startup doesn't always follow the textbook, and that excites rather than unsettles you

 * You coach and facilitate, you don't enforce, you know the difference between guiding a team and policing a process

 * Calm under pressure, direct without being rigid

 * Genuinely curious about the product, not just the process

 * CSM, PSM or equivalent is a plus, but how you actually work matters more

 * Fluent English; German is welcome

Benefits

What's extra?

 * Salary: €3.800 - €5.200 gross/month depending on experience

 * Yearly public transport card (Vienna)

 * Workation within the EEA

 * Dog-friendly offices

 * "Inspire Days" - time to learn and recharge

 * A front-row seat to how a deep-tech hardware product gets built, from PCB to shipped device

 * Small, international team where your impact is visible every day

Ready to be the person who keeps a brilliant, complex team connected and moving?

We can't wait to meet you.
